method: Owner-approved Corona Crest at the 37 px rung (skull rule). Fresh built-in GPT Image generations (lead-run Sol lane); image 1 = his own approved frames for each pose (one-limb canon: feathered wing-arms, gloved hands at the wing ends), image 2 = canon-correct Solar style. Fixed scale per image locked on the goggle band (skull proxy), centre-sampled reduction into Solar palette roles, outer silhouette ink on the dark bronze contour slot, registration to the rescaled normal frame of the same pose. Flash beat on fixed white/cream roles. No native pixels shipped.
one_limb_audit: Every Solar frame checked against the canon: flight, ascend, roll, spindash and spring spread or wrap the wings; idle, run, walk, transformation beats 2-4, duck, look up, hurt, skid, balance and push come from gen-plan-5 one-limb regenerations; skid uses v1 (its low fan joins the rear forearm; v2 shows a separate hip fan and was rejected).
